text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City Policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to implement an accessible loading zone on the south side of Elm Street, west of Murray Street, fronting the Charles Hastings Co-op Housing. The establishment of an accessible loading zone will provide unimpeded curb side access for Wheel-Trans.

The Toronto and East York Community Council recommends that: 1. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the south side of Elm Street, between St. Patrick Street and a point opposite the west limit of Murray Street. 2. Prohibited standing at all times on the south side of Elm Street, between St. Patrick Street and a point 16.5 metres east. 3. Designated an accessible loading zone to operate all times on the south side of Elm Street, between a point 16.5 metres east of St. Patrick Street and a point 11 metres further east. 4. Amended the existing standing prohibition in effect at all times on the south side of Elm Street, between a point opposite the west curb line of Murray Street and University Avenue, to be in effect from a point 27.5 metres east of St. Patrick Street and University Avenue.
